basic_info.description: Wonderful detached home with beautiful views of Golden Gate Bridge and city on a quiet street. 3-4 bedrooms, 2 full, 1 half bath, formal dining room, living room with balcony to views. Serene view primary bedroom with fireplace and seating area. Kitchen with peninsula to family/breakfast room. Garage with interior access + 2 car parking in driveway. Elevator to all levels. Incredible light filled home!
